title: Rune Technologies Wins $99 Million U.S. Army Contract For AI-Powered Predictive Logistics Platform | Rune Technologies News
summary: Rune Technologies secured a $99 million five-year contract from the U.S. Army to provide its AI-powered TyrOS logistics platform across military organizations.
body_markdown:
Pulse2.0 covered Rune Technologies by Amit Chowdhry in a piece titled “Rune Technologies Wins $99 Million U.S. Army Contract For AI-Powered Predictive Logistics Platform.” Rune Technologies secured a $99 million five-year contract from the U.S. Army to provide its AI-powered TyrOS logistics platform across military organizations.


Read the full article[here](https://pulse2.com/rune-technologies-wins-99-million-u-s-army-contract-for-ai-powered-predictive-logistics-platform/) .
